errors.text_span: The provided image is not a linear graph; hence, the description cannot be provided based on the given instructions.
errors.evidence: The image is clearly a line plot, but the machine-generated description incorrectly states that it is not a linear graph.
The machine-generated description does not mention the purpose of the chart, which is to illustrate changes in R&D and innovation expenses across sectors over a five-year period.
The machine-generated description does not describe the axes, including the Y-axis range (0 to 200,000) and intervals (50,000), or the lack of markings on the X-axis.
The machine-generated description does not mention the four data series represented by the colored lines (orange, gray, yellow, blue) or their respective labels and trends.
